items.description: WARNING: This game contains visual and audio anomalies, disorienting effects, and psychological horror.You wake up in a decaying zone where time loops and reality fractures. The lights flicker. The corridors repeat. Something is deeply wrong—and it's getting worse.Exit Zone is a memory-based anomaly horror game inspired by Exit 8, designed for 1–5 players. Every corridor looks the same—until it doesn’t.How to SurviveObserve your surroundings. Memorize every room, object, sound, and corridor. Advance only when you're certain everything is normal—then pull the green lever. If anything feels off, hit the red lever before it’s too late. Anomalies can be subtle… or dangerous. One wrong choice, and the zone resets—or worse.Gameplay FeaturesAnomaly Observation Mechanics Spot shifting elements in the environment: misplaced objects, altered text, warped visuals, impossible physics, or entities that shouldn’t exist.Solo or Co-op Multiplayer (1–5 Players) Work together to share memory and identify anomalies—or split up and risk it alone.Randomized Runs Each playthrough generates new anomaly patterns, ensuring replayability and paranoia every time.No Combat – Just Observation The only way out is to observe, remember, and choose the correct path.What Makes Exit Zone Different?True psychological tension – no cheap jumpscares.A haunted world designed to sharpen your perception.Anomalies escalate the longer you remain inside.Every decision matters. Every second counts.Do you remember where the door was? Are you sure that corpse wasn’t here before? One wrong choice, and you’ll be part of the zone forever. Welcome to Exit Zone. items.description: Mei Paranormies is a 2D top-down survival horror game where you play as Mei, the paranormal investigator, who got a call from the owner of a haunted restaurant to check it out for proof of the paranormal.Nokiloc restaurant was built during the 1980s in San Francisco by Rob, the former owner of the restaurant. The business was booming during the late 1980s. But in the year 1990, there was a devastating fire incident that killed a restaurant waiter and a few customers. While most of the people, which included customers and restaurant staff, were evacuated safely by the firefighters. A few of them who were stuck in the restaurant during the evacuation process died either due to suffocation or burns. In 1992, the Nokiloc restaurant was sold to Chris, the current owner, who reopened the restaurant later that year after renovation, and customers started to come in again. But there were reports of paranormal activities in the restaurant. During the night hours, the spirits are often seen sitting on empty chairs, in the kitchen areas, etc. The dark apparitions are also often observed by the restaurant staff in the basement and in the storage rooms. It is said that a spirit with a badly burned face is often seen roaming in the hallways near the staff's bedrooms. Disembodied crying and screaming noises are often heard during the midnight hours. Because of the rise in paranormal activities, the restaurant business got affected. This had compelled the owner, Chris, to contact Mei, the paranormal investigator, to check it out and provide him with some answers.You play as Mei, a paranormal investigator, and will you be able to help out your client?Key Features:Explore the haunted restaurant for the proof of the paranormal.Collect items like keys, haunted objects like ladies bag, engagement ring etc.Come face to face with the spirits!Use scientific equipment like EVP recorder, emf meter!Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation!Warning:This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions.
